What we check before we recommend anything

Most "best peptide" lists rank whoever pays the most. We publish our criteria and show the source and date behind every claim.

Read the full method

  • Evidence

    What human studies show for the use you care about, not what a molecule does in a dish.

  • Regulatory status

    FDA approval, cosmetic or research labeling, and any FDA warning letters sent to the seller.

  • Lab testing

    Whether a third-party certificate of analysis exists and matches the batch you would actually receive.

  • Real price

    Price per milligram or per month, calculated the same way for every seller so the numbers compare.

  • Transparency

    Who runs the company, where it ships from, and whether paid placements are labeled.
